purpose: fresh independent FOCUS training-duration qualification and CauAug source-inference correction; development validation only
data: existing 256x256 HDF5; original six-domain order and train/validation splits; no test access
selection: earliest maximum foreground micro Dice on first metadata validation sequence block each epoch; final remaining validation blocks
limitations: sequence blocks are not verified independent patients
existing HDF5 preprocessing and true domain provenance unverified
validation blocks exposed in earlier experiments
two seeds are developmental, not selected after results
manual FOCUS architecture plan and minibatches-per-epoch; no nnU-Net preprocessing or spatial augmentation pipeline
CauAug source UNet at 256 versus official 192; explicit slice-level minmax [0,1] because case boundaries unavailable, not claimed author case minmax
FOCUS 150 epochs now matches original benchmark epoch count but not author250 epochs or250 minibatches/epoch; backbones and per-epoch resource costs differ
CauAug batch-statistic inference must be explicitly disclosed; no post-hoc favorable seed/checkpoint selection
validation-only correction and protocol development; no independent final-performance claim

focus.network: author Generic_UNet_sparse, 32 base features, 6 pooling stages, 480 cap, InstanceNorm, deep supervision
focus.replay: first-level features plus hard distilled targets; uniform domain allocation with foreground sampling; alternate new/replay updates
focus.optimizer: SGD lr .01 momentum .99 Nesterov weight decay 3e-5 polynomial .9
focus.encoder: frozen after first task; source train-mode handling retained

cauaug.KD: upstream width-axis sum retained literally; probabilities NCHW
cauaug.teacher: weights frozen; source train-mode BN updates retained
cauaug.evaluation: source-style batch-statistic BN, batch size 1, CKNet fixed RNG; BN buffers restored after evaluation to isolate validation; learned parameters unchanged
cauaug.input_adaptation: per-slice minmax [0,1], constant slices to zero; selected before training to satisfy source input range, no test or validation performance used

artifacts: private rolling checkpoint incl optimizer/replay or archive; only cross-seed cross-domain aggregates eligible for publication
failure: nonfinite/data error stops affected method seed pair; no automatic rerun; original clock retained
label_policy: HDF5 contains fractional labels in [0,1]; cast to integer exactly as existing benchmark loader, not threshold .5. Source preprocessing remains unverified.
protocol_revision: v2 frozen before training; original pilot preserved

rationale.cauaug: author evaluation never calls eval and predictor evaluates one slice; fixed-checkpoint 2x2 BN/batch diagnostic shows running-stat collapse; repair source mismatch without changing loss, augmentation or optimizer
rationale.focus: 20 epoch short pilot vs benchmark150/source250; same two seeds freshly initialized at 150 epochs to assess training sufficiency; not fine hyperparameter search

prior_results: prior fixed-checkpoint diagnostic only informed source mismatch diagnosis, not choice among checkpoints or seeds
public_usage: Requires separately obtained author checkouts at pinned commits. Set REFERENCE_ROOT, DATA_ROOT, WORK_ROOT, ARM_METHOD and ARM_SEED; copy this protocol as WORK_ROOT/protocol.json. Launch only under an appropriate local time/storage guard. Third-party code and private data are not distributed.
